guide.tea_art.title: Tea Art Guide
guide.tea_art.overview: This guide records the six tea categories, processing routes, brewing flow, and in-game effects.
guide.tea_art.wild_tea: Wild tea trees: found in jungles, bamboo jungles, forests, cherry groves, meadows, and old-growth woods. Harvest them for tea leaves and seeds.
guide.tea_art.green: Green tea: tea leaf -> pan fixation -> rolling table -> sieve-rack drying; unfermented, fresh and clear.
guide.tea_art.white: White tea: tea leaf -> sieve-rack drying; gentle and sweet.
guide.tea_art.yellow: Yellow tea: tea leaf -> pan fixation -> rolling table -> charcoal-roaster yellowing -> sieve-rack drying; mellow and mild.
guide.tea_art.red: Red tea: tea leaf -> withering tray -> rolling table -> fermentation vat -> sieve-rack drying; fully fermented, bright and sweet.
guide.tea_art.black: Dark tea: tea leaf -> pan fixation -> rolling table -> pile fermentation -> sieve-rack drying; post-fermented, thick and mellow.
guide.tea_art.oolong: Oolong tea: tea leaf -> withering tray -> rolling table greening -> fermentation-vat fixation -> rolling table -> sieve-rack drying; fragrant and rich.
guide.tea_art.jasmine: Flower tea: put white tea, jasmine or gardenia flowers, and fuel into the scenting box. The white tea records the scenting process, then dries into flower tea on a tea sieve.
guide.tea_art.brew.step1: 1. Right-click the teapot with a hot water bottle. The bottle returns as an empty glass bottle.
guide.tea_art.brew.step2: 2. Right-click the teapot with finished tea leaves to start steeping.
guide.tea_art.brew.step3: 3. After the ready sound, right-click the teapot with a tea cup to pour the infusion.
guide.tea_art.effect.green: Green tea infusion: Haste II for 1:00 and Night Vision for 5:00.
guide.tea_art.effect.white: White tea infusion: Haste I for 1:00 and Night Vision for 5:00.
guide.tea_art.effect.yellow: Yellow tea infusion: Haste II and Speed II for 3:00.
guide.tea_art.effect.red: Red tea infusion: Haste II and Speed II for 3:00.
guide.tea_art.effect.black: Dark tea infusion: Resistance II and Absorption for 3:00, plus Regeneration I for 0:10.
guide.tea_art.effect.oolong: Oolong tea infusion: Haste II and Speed II for 5:00.
guide.tea_art.effect.jasmine: Jasmine flower tea infusion: Regeneration I for 0:20 and Night Vision for 5:00.
guide.tea_art.effect.gardenia: Gardenia tea infusion: Haste I for 3:00 and Regeneration I for 0:20.
guide.tea_art.tool.pan: Tea roasting pan: fixation and drying, also finishes yellow tea and dark tea. Wait for the heat, then collect.
guide.tea_art.tool.tray: Withering tray: softens fresh leaves for white tea, red tea, and oolong tea. Pale particles show the leaves airing.
guide.tea_art.tool.table: Rolling table: rolls withered leaves and prepares red tea for fermentation. Right-click again to collect.
guide.tea_art.tool.vat: Fermentation vat: red tea fermentation, dark tea pile fermentation, and oolong fixation. It releases bubbles and steam.
guide.tea_art.tool.roaster: Charcoal roaster: yellowing for yellow tea. Sparks and fire sounds mark the roast.
guide.tea_art.tool.teapot: Teapot: add hot water, add tea leaves, wait, then pour with a tea cup.
guide.tea_art.flow: Plant tea trees -> harvest leaves -> process six tea categories -> brew in a teapot -> drink infusions -> unlock advancements.
